children: On September 10, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq letter granting an additional 180-day period, until March 8, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). There is no immediate impact on the Nasdaq listing; compliance will be achieved if the closing bid price is at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (which may be extended to up to 20 days), and the company may consider a reverse stock split if needed.
